name: Amazon Web Services
how_to_set: New account: choose the Free plan at sign-up (credits only, no charges until you upgrade).
Paid account: Billing and Cost Management > Budgets > Create budget (monthly cost, your amount, email alerts at 80% actual and 100% forecast).
Add a Budget Action on the same budget: apply the deny policy from infra/budgets/aws (stops new compute and storage) at 100%.
Where offered: AWS Settings (settings.aws.com) > Billing > Spend limit, with "Stop new resource launches" on.
kill_switch: Budget Action applies an IAM deny policy (or stops EC2/RDS) at the threshold; existing running resources still bill until stopped.
traps: NAT gateways bill per hour and per GB even when idle
Public IPv4 addresses bill per hour, attached or not
Billing data lags by hours, so alerts arrive late
Leaked access keys used for crypto mining
Resources left in a forgotten region
unverified: AWS Settings spend limit is in limited release; availability for a given account is unverified
